description: The image displays four pie charts, each representing the distribution of error types for a different language model: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The GPT4-o chart shows two categories: "Lack of Knowledge" at 83.3% (red) and "1" at 16.7% (light orange). The Gemini1.5-Pro chart is divided into four segments: "Misinformation" at 38.4% (orange), "Lack of Knowledge" at 22.1% (blue), "Ethical Advice" at 16.3% (light blue), and "Clarification" at 14.0% (yellow), with a small "Safety" segment at 9.3% (dark red). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has two segments: "Lack of Knowledge" at 75.0% (orange) and "Clarification" at 25.0% (red). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart also has two segments: "Lack of Knowledge" at 50.0% (light orange) and "Misinformation" at 50.0% (red). Each chart uses distinct colors to differentiate the categories, and the percentages are labeled within or near each slice.
